description: href="DATA:text/css,..." (upper-case scheme) is not recognised as a data: URI by critical, which treats it as a file path and fails the job.

thin.note: The URL scheme is case-insensitive: DATA: is decoded exactly like data: (one rule, no special failure), so the job succeeds and the rule is included. expected-thin.css is critical's output for the same page with a lower-case data: scheme and the same payload.
